title: How Do Neural Networks Work? Step-by-Step Guide to Deep Learning Algorithms

cues.en: -: All right, exciting tutorial ahead.
cues.zh: 講師：接下來精彩。

cues.en: Welcome back to the course on deep learning.
cues.zh: 歡迎回深度學習。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about how do neural networks work.
cues.zh: 今天談神經網路如何運作。

cues.en: Now, we've laid a lot of groundwork, we've talked about how neural networks are structured, what elements they consist of, and even their functionality.
cues.zh: 已有很多基礎，架構、元素，甚至功能。

cues.en: And today, we're going to look at a real example of how a neural network can be applied and we're actually gonna work step by step through the process of its application
cues.zh: 今天看真實應用例，一步步走過應用流程，

cues.en: so we know what's going on.
cues.zh: 了解情況。

cues.en: So, let's have a look, what example we're going to be talking about?
cues.zh: 要談哪個例子？

cues.en: We're going to be looking at property valuation.
cues.zh: 房地產估價。

cues.en: So, we're going to look at a neural network that takes in some parameters of our property and values it.
cues.zh: 網路輸入房屋參數，再估價。

cues.en: And the thing here, there's a small caveat for today's tutorial and that is we're not actually going to train the network.
cues.zh: 今天小提醒，不會真的訓練網路。

cues.en: So, a very important part in neural networks is training them up.
cues.zh: 訓練是重要部分。

cues.en: And we're going to look at that in the next tutorials in this section.
cues.zh: 本單元後幾堂看。

cues.en: For now, we're going to focus on the actual application.
cues.zh: 先著重實際應用。

cues.en: So, we're going to work with a neural network that we're going to pretend is already trained up and that will allow us to focus on the application side of things
cues.zh: 假裝網路已訓練好，讓我們專注應用，

cues.en: and not get bogged down in the training aspect.
cues.zh: 不陷訓練細節。

cues.en: And then we'll cover off the training when we already know the end goal we're working towards.
cues.zh: 知道最終目標後再學訓練。

cues.en: Sound good?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: All right, let's jump straight into it.
cues.zh: 直接開始。

cues.en: So, let's say we have some input parameters, right?
cues.zh: 假設有輸入參數。

cues.en: So, let's say we have four parameters about the property.
cues.zh: 四個房屋參數。

cues.en: We have area in the squared feet, we have the number of bedrooms, the distance to the city in miles, the nearest city and the age of the property.
cues.zh: 平方英尺面積、臥室數、距最近城市英里數，以及屋齡。

cues.en: And all of those four are going to comprise our input layer.
cues.zh: 四個構成輸入層。

cues.en: Now, of course they're probably way more parameters that define the price of a property, but for simplicity's sake, we're going to look at just these four.
cues.zh: 當然影響房價更多，但簡化只看四個。

cues.en: Now, in its very basic form, a neural network only has an input layer and an output layer.
cues.zh: 最基本網路只有輸入與輸出層。

cues.en: So, no hidden layers.
cues.zh: 沒隱藏層。

cues.en: And our output layer is the price that we're predicting.
cues.zh: 輸出是預測價格。

cues.en: So, in this form, what these input variables would do is they would just be weighted up by the synapses, and then the output there would be calculated
cues.zh: 此形式，輸入由突觸加權，再算輸出，

cues.en: or basically, the price would be calculated and we would get a price.
cues.zh: 也就是價格。

cues.en: And for instance, the price could be calculated as simple as the weighted sum of all of the inputs.
cues.zh: 例如直接計算全部輸入加權和。

cues.en: And again, here you could use pretty much any function.
cues.zh: 也能幾乎任何函數。

cues.en: You could use what we're using now, we could use any of the activation functions we had previously, you could use a logistic regression,
cues.zh: 現在這個、先前活化函數、邏輯斯迴歸，

cues.en: you could use a squared function, you could use pretty much anything here.
cues.zh: 平方函數，幾乎任何都行。

cues.en: But the point is that you get a certain output.
cues.zh: 重點得到某個輸出。

cues.en: And moreover, most of the machine learning algorithms that exist can be represented in this format.
cues.zh: 甚至多數現有機器學習演算法，可用此形式表示。

cues.en: This is basically a diagrammatic representation of how you deal with the the variables, right?
cues.zh: 基本是變數處理的圖示。

cues.en: By changing the weights, the formulas, you can accomplish quite a lot of the machine learning algorithms that we've talked about before and put them into this form.
cues.zh: 改權重、公式，就能表達很多先前演算法。

cues.en: And that just stands to show how powerful neural networks are, that even without the hidden layers, we already have a representation that works for most other machine learning algorithms.
cues.zh: 顯示網路很強，沒隱藏層就已能表示大多其他演算法。

cues.en: But in neural networks, what we do have is an extra advantage that gives us lots of flexibility and power, which is where that increase in accuracy comes from.
cues.zh: 但網路多個優勢，讓彈性、能力大增，也是準確率提升來源。

cues.en: And that power is the hidden layers.
cues.zh: 就是隱藏層。

cues.en: And there we go, that's our hidden layer, we've added it in, and now we're going to understand how that hidden layer gives us that extra power.
cues.zh: 加入了，現在了解如何帶來額外能力。

cues.en: And in fact, to do that, we're going to walk through an example.
cues.zh: 用例子走一遍。

cues.en: So, as we agreed, this neural network has already been trained up and now we're just going to plug in, we're going to imagine that we're plugging in a property and we're going to walk step by step
cues.zh: 如約定，已訓練，想像輸入一間房，逐步看

cues.en: through how the neural network will deal with the input variables and calculate the hidden layer and then calculate the output layer.
cues.zh: 如何處理輸入、計算隱藏層與輸出層。

cues.en: So, let's go through this.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: This is gonna be exciting.
cues.zh: 會很精彩。

cues.en: All right, we've got all four variables on the left and we're going to first start with the top neuron on the hidden layer.
cues.zh: 左邊四變數，先隱藏層最上神經元。

cues.en: Now, as we previously saw, in the previous tutorials, all of the neurons from the input layer, they have synopsis connecting each one of them
cues.zh: 前面看過，所有輸入神經元都有突觸，分別連到

cues.en: to the top neuron in the hidden layer.
cues.zh: 隱藏層最上神經元。

cues.en: And those synopsis have weights.
cues.zh: 突觸有權重。

cues.en: Now, let's agree that some weights will have a non-zero value, some weights will have a zero value because basically, not all inputs will be valid,
cues.zh: 約定有些非零、有些零，因為不一定所有輸入都有效，

cues.en: or not all inputs will be important for every single neuron.
cues.zh: 或對每個神經元都重要。

cues.en: Sometimes inputs will not be important.
cues.zh: 有時不重要。

cues.en: And here we can see two examples, that X one and X three, the area and the distance to the city in miles are important for that neuron, whereas bedrooms and age are not.
cues.zh: 這裡 X₁、X₃，面積、距離重要，臥室、屋齡不重要。

cues.en: Like, and let's think about this for a second.
cues.zh: 想一下。

cues.en: How would that be the case?
cues.zh: 為何如此？

cues.en: Like why would a certain neuron be linked to the area and the distance?
cues.zh: 為何神經元連面積與距離？

cues.en: What could that mean?
cues.zh: 可能代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, that could mean that normally, the further away you get from the city, the cheaper real estate becomes, and therefore the space in square feet of properties becomes larger, right?
cues.zh: 通常離城市越遠，房越便宜，面積越大。

cues.en: So, for the same price, you can get a larger property the further way you go from the city, that's normal, right?
cues.zh: 同價格，遠一點可買更大，很正常。

cues.en: That makes sense.
cues.zh: 合理。

cues.en: And probably what this neuron is doing is it is looking specifically, it's like a sniper, it's looking for properties which are not so far
cues.zh: 它可能像狙擊手，專找離城市不太遠，

cues.en: from the city, but have a large area.
cues.zh: 但面積大的房。

cues.en: So, for their distance from the city, they have an unfair square foot area, right?
cues.zh: 以距離而言，面積大得不尋常。

cues.en: So, something that's abnormal, it's higher than average.
cues.zh: 異常、高於平均。

cues.en: So, they're quite close to the city, but they're still large as opposed to the other ones at the same distance.
cues.zh: 相較同距離房屋，靠城但仍大。

cues.en: And so, that neuron, again, we're speculating here, but that neuron might be picking out, laser picking out those specific properties and it will activate, then hence the activation function,
cues.zh: 只是推測，但可能精準挑這些房，符合時活化，所以叫活化函數，

cues.en: it'll activate, it'll fire up only when the certain criteria is met, that distance to the city
cues.zh: 只有符合距離

cues.en: and the area of the area of the property, and it performs its own calculations inside itself and it combines those two and as soon as a certain criteria is met, it fires up,
cues.zh: 與面積條件才觸發；內部計算、結合兩者，符合條件就觸發，

cues.en: and that contributes to the price in the output layer.
cues.zh: 對輸出價格作貢獻。

cues.en: And therefore, this neuron doesn't really care about bedrooms and age of the property because it's focused on that specific thing.
cues.zh: 因此不管臥室與屋齡，只專注這點。

cues.en: That's where the power of the neural network comes from because you have many of these neurons and we'll see just now how the other ones work.
cues.zh: 網路力量在很多這種神經元，馬上看其他。

cues.en: So, but what I wanted to agree here is that let's not even draw these lines for the synopsis that are not in play so that we don't clutter up our image.
cues.zh: 但先約定，不畫沒作用突觸，避免圖擁擠。

cues.en: That's the only reason we're not gonna draw them.
cues.zh: 唯一原因如此。

cues.en: So, let's just get rid of those two and that way we will know exactly, okay, so this neuron is focused on area and distance to the city.
cues.zh: 去掉兩線，就清楚它專注面積、距離。

cues.en: All right, so as long as we agree on that, let's move on to the next one.
cues.zh: 同意就下一個。

cues.en: Let's take the one in the middle.
cues.zh: 中間。

cues.en: Here, we've got three parameters feeding into this neuron.
cues.zh: 三參數進入。

cues.en: So, we've got the area, the bedrooms and the age of the property.
cues.zh: 面積、臥室、屋齡。

cues.en: So, what could be the reason here?
cues.zh: 可能原因？

cues.en: Again, let's try to understand the intuition, the thinking of this neuron.
cues.zh: 試著理解直覺、它的思考。

cues.en: How is this neuron thinking?
cues.zh: 怎麼想？

cues.en: Why is it picking these three parameters?
cues.zh: 為何挑這三個？

cues.en: What could have it like found in the data, right?
cues.zh: 可能在資料找到什麼？

cues.en: So, we've already established this is a trained up data set.
cues.zh: 已假設訓練完成。

cues.en: The training has happened a long time ago, maybe like a day ago, or somebody's already trained up this data.
cues.zh: 很早前，也許一天前，有人已訓練。

cues.en: So, now we're just applying and we know that this neuron, through all the thousands of examples of properties has found out that the area plus the bedrooms plus the age, combination of those parameters is important.
cues.zh: 現在應用，知道它透過數千房例，發現面積加臥室加屋齡的組合重要。

cues.en: Why could that be the case?
cues.zh: 為何？

cues.en: Well, for instance, maybe in that specific city, in those suburbs that this neural network has been trained up in,
cues.zh: 例如訓練所在城市、郊區，

cues.en: perhaps there's a lot of families with kids, with two or more children who are looking for large properties with lots of bedrooms,
cues.zh: 很多有兩個以上孩子的家庭，找大房、多臥室，

cues.en: which are new, right?
cues.zh: 又新的。

cues.en: Which are not old properties, because maybe in that area, most of the properties are kind of like, big properties are usually old,
cues.zh: 不是舊房，因為當地通常大房較舊，

cues.en: but there's lots of modern families, and maybe there was has been a social demographic shift and or maybe there's been like a lot of some growth
cues.zh: 但現代家庭很多，也許社會人口結構轉變，或

cues.en: in terms of employment and jobs for the younger side of population.
cues.zh: 年輕人就業成長。

cues.en: Maybe just like the population demographics have changed and now younger couples or younger families are looking for properties,
cues.zh: 人口結構變了，年輕夫妻或家庭找房，

cues.en: but they prefer newer properties.
cues.zh: 偏好新房。

cues.en: So, they want the age of the property to be lower.
cues.zh: 希望屋齡低。

cues.en: And hence, from the training that this neural network has undergone, it knows that when there's a property with a large area, and with lots of bedrooms, with at least three bedrooms for the parents,
cues.zh: 所以訓練讓網路知道，面積大、多臥室，至少三間，給父母、

cues.en: for the first child, for the second child, with at least three bedrooms, maybe a guest room, when a new property with a high area and lots of bedrooms, that is valued, in that market, that is valuable.
cues.zh: 第一個孩子、第二個孩子，也許客房；新、大、多房，在這市場有價值。

cues.en: So, that neuron has picked that up, it knows that, okay, so this is what I'm gonna be looking for, I don't care about the distance to the city in miles, wherever it is, as long as it has high area
cues.zh: 神經元學到，知道要找這種，不管距城市多遠，只要面積大、

cues.en: and lots of bedrooms, as soon as that criteria is met, the neuron fires up, and the combination of these three parameters, and this is again, this is where the power of the neural network is coming from
cues.zh: 臥室多，符合就觸發。這三參數組合，再次是網路能力來源，

cues.en: because it combines these three parameters into a brand new parameter, into a brand new attribute that helps with the evaluation,
cues.zh: 把三者結合為全新參數、屬性，幫助估價，

cues.en: helps with the evaluation of the property.
cues.zh: 估房價。

cues.en: It combines them into a new attribute and therefore, it's more precise.
cues.zh: 組成新屬性，所以更精準。

cues.en: So, there we go, that's how that neuron works.
cues.zh: 這個神經元如此。

cues.en: And let's look at another one.
cues.zh: 再另一個。

cues.en: Let's look at the very bottom one.
cues.zh: 最下。

cues.en: For instance, this neuron could even have picked up just one parameter, it could have just picked up age and not any of the other ones.
cues.zh: 可能只學到一參數，屋齡，不用其他。

cues.en: And how could that be the case?
cues.zh: 為何？

cues.en: Well, this is a classic example of when age could mean, like as we all know, the older the property is, usually it's less valuable because it's worn out, probably the building is old,
cues.zh: 典型例子，通常越老越不值錢，磨損、建築老，

cues.en: probably things are falling apart, more maintenance is required.
cues.zh: 東西可能壞、維修多。

cues.en: So, the price drops in terms of the price of the real estate, whereas a brand new building, it would be more expensive because it's brand new.
cues.zh: 所以房價降，新建築更貴。

cues.en: But perhaps if a property is over a certain age, that could indicate that it's a historic property.
cues.zh: 但超過某年齡，可能是歷史建物。

cues.en: For instance, if a property is under 100 years old, then the older it is, the less valuable it is.
cues.zh: 例如未滿百年，越老越便宜。

cues.en: But as soon as it jumps over 100 years old, all of a sudden it becomes a historic property.
cues.zh: 一過百年，突然成歷史建物。

cues.en: Because this is a property where people used to live hundreds of years ago.
cues.zh: 幾百年前就有人住。

cues.en: It tells a story, it's got all this history behind it, and some people like that, some people value that.
cues.zh: 有故事、歷史，有些人喜歡、珍惜。

cues.en: In fact, quite a lot of people would like that and would be proud to live in a property, and especially in the higher socioeconomic classes, they would show off to their friends or things like that.
cues.zh: 其實很多人喜歡，以住這裡為傲，尤其較高社經階層，向朋友炫耀等。

cues.en: And therefore properties that are over 100 years old could be deemed as historic, and therefore this neuron, as soon as it sees a property over 100 years old,
cues.zh: 所以過百年可視為歷史建物，神經元看到超百年，

cues.en: it'll fire up and contribute to the overall price.
cues.zh: 就觸發，對總價作貢獻。

cues.en: And otherwise, if it's under 100 years old, then it won't even work.
cues.zh: 未滿百年就不作用。

cues.en: And this is a good example of the rectifier function being applied.
cues.zh: 這是整流函數好例。

cues.en: So, here you've got like a zero until a certain point, let's say 100 years old, and then after 100 years old, the older it gets, the higher the contribution
cues.zh: 某點之前為 0，例如一百年；之後越老，

cues.en: of this neuron to the overall price.
cues.zh: 對總價貢獻越高。

cues.en: And it's just a wonderful example, a very simple example of this rectifier function in action.
cues.zh: 整流作用的絕佳簡例。

cues.en: So there we go, that could be this neuron.
cues.zh: 可能是這神經元。

cues.en: And moreover, the neural network could have even picked up things that we wouldn't have thought of ourselves, right?
cues.zh: 甚至網路能學我們沒想過的。

cues.en: For instance, bedrooms plus distance to the city, maybe that's in combination somehow contributes to the price.
cues.zh: 臥室加距離，也許組合影響房價。

cues.en: Maybe it's not as strong as the other neurons and it contributes, but it still contributes, or maybe it detracts from the price.
cues.zh: 可能沒其他強，但仍貢獻，或拉低價格。

cues.en: That could also be the case, or other things like that.
cues.zh: 也可能如此，類似事情。

cues.en: And maybe a neuron picked up a combination of all four of these parameters.
cues.zh: 也許有神經元學全部四個組合。

cues.en: And as you can see that these neurons, this whole hidden layer situation allows you to increase the flexibility
cues.zh: 這些神經元、隱藏層讓你提高

cues.en: of your neural network
cues.zh: 網路彈性，

cues.en: and allows the neural network to look for very specific things.
cues.zh: 找出很特定的事物。

cues.en: And then in combination, that's where the power comes from.
cues.zh: 組合起來就是力量來源。

cues.en: It's like that example of the ants, right?
cues.zh: 像螞蟻例子。

cues.en: Like an ant by itself cannot build in anthill, but when you have like 1,000 or 100,000 ants, they can build an anthill together, right?
cues.zh: 一隻建不了蟻丘，一千或十萬隻就可一起建。

cues.en: And that's the situation here, each one of these neurons by itself cannot predict the price, but together they have superpowers and they predict the price, and they can do quite an accurate job if trained properly,
cues.zh: 每個神經元自己不會預測房價，但一起有超能力；訓練適當、

cues.en: if set up properly.
cues.zh: 設定適當，就很準。

cues.en: And that's what this whole course is about in understanding how to utilize them.
cues.zh: 本課就是了解如何運用。

cues.en: There we go, so that is a step by step example and walk through of how neural networks actually work.
cues.zh: 這就是網路如何運作的逐步例子。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed today's tutorial and I can't wait to see you next time.
cues.zh: 希望喜歡，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy deep learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受深度學習的樂趣。
